sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MODELS INDICATE THAT A STRONG MID-LATITUDE PACIFIC JET...NOW APPROACHING THE BRITISH COLUMBIA COAST...WILL STEADILY NOSE INLAND ALONG THE WESTERN U.S./CANADIAN BORDER DURING THIS FORECAST PERIOD. UPPER RIDGING ACROSS BRITISH COLUMBIA AND THE PACIFIC NORTHWEST IS EXPECTED TO FLATTEN AS IT DOES...WHILE A DOWNSTREAM MID-LEVEL CLOSED LOW AND ASSOCIATED SHORT WAVE IMPULSE GRADUALLY ACCELERATE EASTWARD ACROSS THE UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY AND UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION. GUIDANCE SUGGESTS THAT THIS LATTER FEATURE WILL SUPPORT SIGNIFICANT SURFACE CYCLOGENESIS ACROSS NORTHWEST ONTARIO...AND AN ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT MAY SURGE SOUTHEAST OF THE NORTHERN PLAINS THROUGH MUCH OF THE UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION AND UPPER HALF OF THE MISSISSIPPI VALLEY BY 12Z SUNDAY. AS UPPER TROUGHING PERSISTS EAST OF THE ATLANTIC COAST...SURFACE RIDGING LIKELY WILL REMAIN PROMINENT ACROSS MUCH OF THE ATLANTIC SEABOARD INTO THE CENTRAL AND EASTERN GULF STATES. GUIDANCE INDICATES THAT MODEST SOUTHERLY FLOW TO THE WEST OF THIS FEATURE...AND TO THE SOUTH AND EAST OF THE COLD FRONT...WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT A NORTHWARD RETURN FLOW OF MID 60S TO NEAR 70F SURFACE DEW POINTS NOW PRESENT ACROSS MUCH OF THE SOUTHERN PLAINS AND

sections.title: CNTRL PLAINS/MID MS VALLEY INTO SRN GREAT LAKES
sections.text: MOISTURE RETURN COUPLED WITH STEEPENING LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC LAPSE RATES ASSOCIATED WITH EASTWARD ADVECTING ELEVATED MIXED LAYER AIR APPEAR LIKELY TO CONTRIBUTE TO SIZABLE CAPE ACROSS A RATHER LARGE AREA OF THE CENTRAL PLAINS AND MID MISSISSIPPI VALLEY. BY PEAK BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING...GUIDANCE INDICATES VALUES OF 2000-3000+ J/KG ARE LIKELY. COINCIDING WITH AT LEAST SOME STRENGTHENING OF THE CURRENT GENERALLY LIGHT WESTERLY MEAN FLOW REGIME...THE ENVIRONMENT IS EXPECTED TO BECOME CONDUCIVE TO THE EVOLUTION OF ORGANIZED STORM CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING STRONG DEEP COLD POOLS...SOME OF WHICH MAY EVENTUALLY CONSOLIDATE INTO ONE LARGE EASTWARD AND SOUTHWARD PROPAGATING MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM BY LATE THIS EVENING. IT REMAINS UNCLEAR WHETHER PRIMARY ACTIVITY WILL INITIATE WITH RE-INTENSIFICATION OF THE REMNANTS OF THE CONVECTIVE CLUSTER NOW ADVANCING ACROSS NORTHERN KANSAS. BUT MODELS ARE GENERALLY SUGGESTIVE THAT SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL MAY INCREASE BY MID DAY ACROSS PARTS OF NORTHERN KANSAS/SOUTHEASTERN NEBRASKA AND WESTERN IOWA. INITIALLY LARGE HAIL MAY BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT... WITH SUPERCELL STRUCTURES POSSIBLE...ALONG WITH PERHAPS A COUPLE OF BRIEF TORNADOES. HOWEV

sections.title: IA/MO/IL/WI/MI
sections.text: SCATTERED TSTMS CONTINUE TO INCREASE ACROSS SOUTHERN IA/NORTHERN MO INTO IL/INDIANA AT MID-AFTERNOON WITHIN AN UNSTABLE/WEAKLY CAPPED BOUNDARY LAYER AHEAD OF AN MCV NEAR NORTHWEST MO. ONLY OUTLOOK CHANGE WAS TO INTRODUCE A CORRIDOR OF SLIGHTLY HIGHER WIND PROBABILITIES PER SEVERE TSTM WATCHES 400/401.

sections.title: SOUTHEAST CO TO TX/OK PANHANDLES
sections.text: LIMITED SPATIAL ADJUSTMENTS TO EXISTING SLIGHT RISK WERE MADE TO ACCOUNT FOR DEVELOPMENTAL TRENDS NEAR THE CO FRONT RANGE...BUT SCENARIO OTHERWISE REMAINS AS PREVIOUSLY FORECAST.

sections.title: FAR EAST/NORTHEAST MN AND NORTHWEST WI
sections.text: RELATIVELY LOW-TOPPED STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP/INCREASE IMMEDIATELY AHEAD OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH ACROSS SOUTHERN MANITOBA/NORTHERN MN. A FEW STORMS MAY PRODUCE DAMAGING WINDS/SOME HAIL. ..GUYER.. 06/16/2012 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1129 AM CDT SAT JUN 16 2012/

sections.title: IA/MO/IL/WI/MI
sections.text: SATELLITE/RADAR IMAGERY SHOW A SERIES OF REMNANT MCVS OVER PARTS OF NEB/KS/OK. THESE FEATURES HAVE BEEN WEAKENING THROUGH THE MORNING...BUT ARE LIKELY TO PERSIST IN SUFFICIENT STRENGTH INTO THE AFTERNOON TO ENHANCE CONVECTIVE RE-DEVELOPMENT OVER PARTS OF IA/MO. THE AIR MASS OVER THIS REGION HAS BEEN RAPIDLY DESTABILIZING WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 60S TO LOWER 70S AND MLCAPE VALUES OVER 2000 J/KG NOTED. EFFECTIVE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR IS NOT PARTICULARLY STRONG ACROSS THIS AREA...BUT THE HBR PROFILER NEAR ICT SHOWED A PRONOUNCED MID LEVEL REAR-INFLOW JET ASSOCIATED WITH THE MCV A FEW HOURS AGO. THIS MAY HELP TO ORGANIZE CONVECTION INTO A BOWING SEGMENT LATER TODAY. PRESENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT STORMS WILL FORM FIRST OVER NORTHERN MO/SOUTHERN IA AND TRACK EAST-NORTHEASTWARD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON AND EVENING INTO NORTHERN IL/SOUTHERN WI AND PERHAPS INTO LOWER MI TONIGHT. DAMAGING WINDS ARE LIKELY TO BE THE MAIN THREAT...AS WEAK MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES TEND TO WEAKEN UPDRAFTS AND LIMIT THE LARGE HAIL POTENTIAL.

sections.title: OK
sections.text: THE REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM OVERNIGHT CONVECTION NOW STRETCHES E-W ACROSS CENTRAL OK AND IS DISSIPATING. THIS REGION IS EXPECTED TO BECOME ONLY WEAKLY CAPPED BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON WITH SEVERAL MODEL SOLUTIONS INDICATING THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT. VERTICAL SHEAR AND STEERING FLOW WILL BE WEAK...SUGGESTING SLOW MOVING MULTICELL STORMS. HOWEVER...HIGH CAPE VALUES AND PRESENCE OF BOUNDARY MAY BE SUFFICIENT FOR A FEW SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL.

sections.title: SOUTHEAST CO INTO TX/OK PANHANDLES
sections.text: SOUTHEASTERLY LOW LEVEL WINDS HAVE DEVELOPED ON BACK SIDE OF OVERNIGHT MCS...HELPING TO TRANSPORT MOISTURE WESTWARD INTO SOUTHEAST CO. ISOLATED TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP IN THIS CORRIDOR LATER THIS AFTERNOON AND SPREAD SLOWLY SOUTHEASTWARD DURING THE EVENING. EASTERLY COMPONENT OF LOW LEVEL WINDS WILL COMBINE WITH WEAK WESTERLY FLOW ALOFT FOR SUFFICIENT EFFECTIVE SHEAR FOR OCCASIONAL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES. HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS APPEAR POSSIBLE IN THE STRONGEST STORMS.

sections.title: MID TO UPPER MS VALLEY/SRN GREAT LAKES
sections.text: WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH EXTENDING SWD FROM NW MN INTO IA. A LINEAR MCS IS ONGOING JUST AHEAD OF THE TROUGH AXIS IN WRN IL WITH MESOANALYSIS SHOWING A BROAD WARM SECTOR WITH MODERATE INSTABILITY EXISTING EWD ACROSS IL...IND INTO WRN OH. THE SPRINGFIELD IL 00Z SOUNDING APPEARS TO BE SAMPLING THE STRONGER INSTABILITY WITH 3000 J/KG OF MUCAPE AND A 0-3 KM LAPSE RATE APPROACHING 9.0 C/KM. IN ADDITION...SHORT-TERM MODELS INITIALIZE A 40 KT MID-LEVEL JET MAX JUST BEHIND THE BOWING LINE SEGMENT WHICH APPEARS REASONABLE. THESE FACTORS SHOULD HELP SUSTAIN A SEVERE THREAT EWD ACROSS NCNTRL IL INTO NW IND AND SW MI LATER THIS EVENING. AN EWD MOTION OF 40 KT WITH THE LINE SHOULD SUSTAIN A WIND DAMAGE THREAT WITH THE LINE FOR SEVERAL MORE HOURS. HAIL MAY ALSO OCCUR WITH THE STRONGER CELLS EMBEDDED IN THE LINE BUT THIS SHOULD BE THE LESSER OF THE TWO THREATS.

sections.title: SRN PLAINS
sections.text: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING ACROSS ERN NM...WEST TX EXTENDING EWD INTO NW TX ALONG A NARROW AXIS OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE. ALONG THIS AXIS...MODERATE INSTABILITY IS ANALYZED WITH MLCAPE ESTIMATED FROM 1000 TO 2000 J/KG. IN ADDITION TO THE INSTABILITY...MID-LEVEL LAPSE ARE STEEP EXCEEDING 7.5 C/KM ACROSS MUCH OF THE SRN PLAINS. THIS ALONG WITH SOME DIRECTIONAL SHEAR IN THE LOW TO MID-LEVELS EVIDENT ON REGIONAL WSR 88D VWPS SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR A HAIL THREAT WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS EARLY THIS EVENING. IN ADDITION...LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE STILL STEEP ALONG THE MOIST AXIS SUGGESTING A THREAT WILL EXIST FOR MARGINALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS. THE THREAT SHOULD DIMINISH OVER THE NEXT 2 TO 3 HOURS AS INSTABILITY DECREASES ACROSS THE REGION. ..BROYLES.. 06/17/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP FROM ERN KS THROUGH WRN MO AND SRN IA BY EARLY AFTERNOON. PRIMARY THREATS WILL BE ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND. A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED ONCE INITIATION APPEARS IMMINENT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATE THIS MORNING A TROUGH EXTENDS FROM A WEAK SFC LOW IN EXTREME NERN KS SWWD THROUGH ERN AND SRN KS. ANOTHER CONVERGENCE BOUNDARY EXTENDS EAST FROM THE LOW THROUGH SRN IA. DECAYING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY OR REMNANT GRAVITY WAVE CONTINUES MOVING RAPIDLY FROM NCNTRL MO SWWD THROUGH CNTRL OK. THE ATMOSPHERE IS DESTABILIZING IN WAKE OF THE INITIAL OUTFLOW AND EAST OF TROUGH AXIS FROM ERN KS THROUGH MUCH OF MO AND SRN IA. OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SHOWS PLUME OF STEEPER LAPSE RATES ADVECTING EWD ABOVE MID-UPPER 60S DEWPOINTS. THIS IN CONJUNCTION WITH DIABATIC WARMING SHOULD BOOST MLCAPE TO 2000-2500 J/KG THIS AFTERNOON. PROFILER DATA FROM HOBART KS INDICATE A 50 KT WLY MID LEVEL JET BETWEEN 3 AND 5 KM SOUTH OF AN MCV LOCATED OVER NERN KS. VISIBLE IMAGERY INDICATES A RAPID INCREASE IN MID LEVEL CLOUDS OVER ERN KS...LIKELY INDICATIVE OF MESOSCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THE MCV. AS THIS ZONE OF DEEPER ASCENT CONTINUES EWD THROUGH THE DESTABILIZING ATMOSPHERE...STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP FROM EXTREME ERN KS INTO WRN MO AND SWRN IA. VERTICAL SHEAR IS GENERALLY MODEST SUPPORTING MOSTLY MULTICELLS. HOWEVER...A SMALL ZONE OF 35-40 KT SHEAR EXISTS WITHIN BELT OF STRONGER MID LEVEL FLOW SOUTH OF THE MCV...SUGGESTING A FEW STORMS COULD BECOME BETTER ORGANIZED AND DEVELOP UPDRAFT ROTATION AND BOWING SEGMENTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP FROM NERN MO THROUGH SERN IA AND WRN/NRN IL. PRIMARY THREATS WILL BE ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL. A WW WILL PROBABLY BE NEEDED SOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST VISIBLE IMAGERY SHOW CUMULUS INCREASING ALONG A SW-NE LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE ZONE TROUGH FROM SERN IA INTO NRN IL. A DECAYING OUTFLOW/GRAVITY WAVE WAS ALSO INDICATED MOVING THROUGH ERN AND NERN MO. STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP IN VICINITY OF THESE BOUNDARIES SOON AS THE ATMOSPHERE DESTABILIZES AND CAP WEAKENS WITH MLCAPE FROM 2000-2500 J/KG. WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR WILL SUPPORT MULTICELLS. HOWEVER...THE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT WITH 6.5-7 C/KM LAPSE RATES AND MODERATE INSTABILITY WILL PROMOTE A THREAT OF ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE POSSIBLE ACROSS PORTIONS OF NW TX AND CNTRL OK THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. PRIMARY SEVERE THREATS ARE STRONG WIND GUSTS AND HAIL. ANTICIPATED ISOLATED/BRIEF NATURE OF THE SEVERE THREAT SHOULD PRECLUDE THE NEED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FEW THUNDERSTORMS HAVE INITIATED ALONG A REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY OVER NW TX FROM THE LAST NIGHTS THUNDERSTORMS AMID A DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER. FARTHER NE /ACROSS CNTRL OK/...THE AIR MASS CONTINUES TO DESTABILIZE AND RECENT SATELLITE IMAGERY DEPICTS A MORE AGITATED CB FIELD...SUGGESTING CONVECTIVE INITIATION MAY OCCUR SOON. THE WEAKLY SHEARED/MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT /0-6 KM BULK SHEAR AOB 20 KT AND MLCAPE VALUES AROUND 2000 J/KG PER LATEST RUC ANALYSIS/ ACROSS THE AREA WILL SUPPORT STRONG BUT BRIEF PULSE CONVECTION. DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER ACROSS W TX SUGGESTS THE PRIMARY THREAT WILL BE STRONG WINDS /ALSO SUPPORTED BY DCAPE VALUES AROUND 1200 J/KG PER LATEST RUC ANALYSIS/ WITH A SECONDARY THREAT OF SEVERE HAIL. BETTER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE AND STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ACROSS CNTRL OK APPEAR MORE SUPPORTIVE OF A PRIMARY THREAT OF SEVERE HAIL WITH A SECONDARY THREAT OF STRONG WINDS. ONE ADDITIONAL ITEM OF NOTE...LATEST RAP-BASED MESOANALYSIS SUGGESTS MLCAPE IN EXCESS OF 3000 J/KG ACROSS MUCH OF CNTRL OK. A CLOSER LOOK AT THE RAP SOUNDINGS REVEALS A SUPER-ADIABATIC LAYER NEAR THE SURFACE...CAUSING THE ANALYZED TEMPERATURE TO BE A FEW DEGREE HIGHER THAN OBSERVED. ANTICIPATED ISOLATED/BRIEF NATURE OF THE SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO PRECLUDE THE NEED FOR A WW BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED CLOSELY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL WILL PERSIST THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING FROM NRN MO...SERN IA INTO WRN AND NWRN IL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS CONTINUE DEVELOPING IN ASSOCIATION WITH COMPACT VORT MAX FROM SRN IA INTO NRN MO AS WELL AS FARTHER EAST ALONG CONFLUENCE AXIS IN NWRN IL. MORE ROBUST STORMS WILL REMAIN IN VICINITY OF THE PROGRESSIVE VORT MAX WHERE VERTICAL SHEAR FROM 35-40 KT IS SUFFICIENT FOR ACTIVITY TO BECOME A LITTLE BETTER ORGANIZED WITH POTENTIAL FOR FEW STORMS TO DEVELOP MID LEVEL UPDRAFT ROTATION AND EVOLVE INTO BOWING SEGMENTS. ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE EWD THROUGH INSTABILITY AXIS FROM NERN MO...SERN IA INTO NRN IL DURING THE EVENING. ..DIAL.. 06/16/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SOME UNCERTAINTY LINGERS...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF AN INCREASING SEVERE THREAT THAT COULD REQUIRE AN ADDITIONAL WW THIS EVENING SOUTH OF WWS 400 AND 401.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: IN THE WAKE OF THE CONVECTIVELY GENERATED CYCLONIC VORTICITY CENTER MIGRATING EASTWARD INTO SOUTHEAST IOWA...NEW...DEEPENING CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT PERSISTS SOUTHWEST THROUGH SOUTH AND EAST OF THE KANSAS CITY METRO AREA IN RESPONSE TO LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC WARM ADVECTION. INHIBITION ASSOCIATED WITH EASTWARD ADVECTING ELEVATED MIXED LAYER AIR MAY STILL BE SUPPRESSING CONVECTION...BUT WITH A GRADUAL VEERING OF MID-LEVEL WINDS FROM WESTERLY TO NORTHWESTERLY INTO THE EVENING HOURS...THIS MAY WEAKEN WITH MID-LEVEL COOLING. COINCIDING WITH MODEST SOUTHWESTERLY INFLOW OF MOIST AIR /CHARACTERIZED BY MID 60S TO NEAR 70F SURFACE DEW POINTS ACROSS OKLAHOMA INTO SOUTHEAST KANSAS/...INCREASING INSTABILITY AND VERTICAL SHEAR MAY CONTRIBUTE TO THE EVOLUTION OF AN ADDITIONAL ORGANIZED STORM CLUSTER. THIS SEEMS MOST LIKELY ACROSS THE MISSOURI OZARKS REGION BY 00-03Z...WITH A TENDENCY TO PROPAGATE SOUTHEASTWARD NEAR AND SOUTH OF THE LOWER MISSOURI RIVER VICINITY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ADDITIONAL WW MAY BE NEEDED ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF NORTHERN ILLINOIS WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE ORGANIZED STORM CLUSTER NOW CROSSING THE MISSISSIPPI RIVER... EAST OF MOLINE AND BURLINGTON...WITH A BOW ECHO CONFIGURATION IN RADAR REFLECTIVITIES...APPEARS TO REMAIN VIGOROUS. SOME RECENT WEAKENING HAS BEEN OBSERVED...BUT THIS MAY BE TEMPORARY. LATEST OBJECTIVE INSTABILITY ANALYSES ARE SUGGESTIVE THAT THE ENVIRONMENT MAY STILL BE MODERATELY UNSTABLE...WITH MIXED LAYER CAPE AS HIGH AS 2000 J/KG...IN A CORRIDOR ACROSS NORTHERN ILLINOIS. COUPLED WITH SOME STRENGTHENING OF WESTERLY DEEP LAYER MEAN FLOW...PERHAPS UP TO AROUND 30 KT...DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS...THIS SUPPORTS POTENTIAL FOR RE-INTENSIFICATION AS CONVECTION PROGRESSES EASTWARD. ACTIVITY MAY BEGIN IMPACTING AT LEAST THE SOUTHERN PORTION OF THE CHICAGO METROPOLITAN AREA BY AROUND 03Z...WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS AND SOME HAIL...IN ADDITION TO FREQUENT CLOUD TO GROUND LIGHTNING AND LOCALLY HEAVY RAINFALL. ..KERR.. 06/16/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS MOVING EWD ACROSS SERN CO/NERN NM ARE BEING MONITORED FOR UPSCALE GROWTH INTO AN MCS. IF THIS OCCURS...THEN ISOLATED THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL MAY INCREASE DOWNSTREAM ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE TX/OK PANHANDLES AND SWRN KS. WW DOES NOT APPEAR NECESSARY ATTM.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 23Z...COMPOSITE RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED SMALL CLUSTERS OF THUNDERSTORMS MOVING E AT 30 KT OVER NERN NM...WITH NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT OCCURRING IMMEDIATELY E NEAR THE NM/OK BORDER. ADDITIONAL STORMS...WHICH INCLUDED A BRIEF RM SUPERCELL...WERE LOCATED 20 SSE OF PUB IN SERN CO. AIRMASS AHEAD OF THE NM ACTIVITY IS CHARACTERIZED BY TEMPERATURES NEAR 90F AND DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S. IN ADDITION...SURFACE TO 1 KM FLOW HAS BEGUN TO BACK...WHICH MAY ENHANCE SR INFLOW AND FORWARD PROPAGATION OF CONVECTION IN NM AND CO. GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY /MUCAPE VALUES NEAR 2000 J PER KG/...STEEP LAPSE RATES...AND LOW-LEVEL SELYS VEERING TO WLY IN THE MIDLEVELS...THERE WILL BE AT LEAST MODERATE POTENTIAL FOR AN ORGANIZED MCS TO DEVELOP THIS EVENING/NIGHT IF STORM COVERAGE CAN INCREASE. HOWEVER...UNCERTAINTY IS TOO HIGH ATTM TO SUGGEST A WW WILL BE NECESSARY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: IT IS NOT CERTAIN THAT ANOTHER WW WILL BE NEEDED SOUTH/EAST OF WWS 401 AND 402...BUT TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF A CONTINUING/INCREASING SEVERE THREAT THAT MAY REQUIRE ONE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AS A SURFACE CYCLONE DEEPENS OVER NORTHWEST ONTARIO...MODEST SOUTHERLY 850 MB JET STRENGTHENING IS FORECAST AHEAD OF A TRAILING SURFACE FRONT...WITH 30+ KTS BECOMING MORE PROMINENT AS LEAST AS FAR SOUTH AS NORTHERN ILLINOIS. VARIABILITY EXISTS AMONG THE MODEL GUIDANCE CONCERNING THE STRENGTH OF THE LOWER FLOW FIELDS FARTHER SOUTH...INTO THE MIDDLE MISSISSIPPI VALLEY. AND THIS WILL IMPACT THE EXTENT OF THE CONTINUING SEVERE RISK THIS EVENING...AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER AHEAD OF THE STILL EVOLVING MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM SLOWLY BEGINS TO STABILIZE WITH RADIATIONAL SURFACE COOLING. BUT CLOUD TOPS HAVE BEEN COOLING WITH CONSOLIDATING STORMS OVER CENTRAL MISSOURI...WHICH COULD BEGIN IMPACTING THE ST. LOUIS METROPOLITAN AREA DURING THE 02-04Z TIME FRAME. ..KERR.. 06/17/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ADDITIONAL WWS ARE NOT ANTICIPATED. WWS 402 AND 403 MAY BE CANCELLED EARLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: GIVEN THE RELATIVELY MODEST TO WEAK STRENGTH OF THE SYSTEM RELATIVE INFLOW...AND CONTINUED COOLING OF THE INFLOW SOURCE REGION...CONSIDERABLE WEAKENING OF THE MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM HAS OCCURRED DURING THE PAST HOUR OR SO. THERE APPEARS LITTLE SUPPORT FOR RE-INTENSIFICATION...AND MORE RAPID DISSIPATION OF ACTIVITY APPEARS POSSIBLE AS IT PROGRESSES EASTWARD THROUGH 04-06Z. ..KERR.. 06/17/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE NEED FOR A NEW WW IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED...BUT TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VIGOROUS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT PERSISTS ACROSS THE LAKE OF THE OZARKS REGION...MOSTLY ALONG AND JUST TO THE COOL SIDE OF AN OUFLOW BOUNDARY GENERATED BY THE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM SHIFTING OFF TO THE EAST OF THE MISSISSIPPI VALLEY. ACTIVITY SPREADING ACROSS THE FORT LEONARD WOOD AREA MAY STILL BE GENERALLY BOUNDARY LAYER BASED ...AND COULD CONTINUE TO BE ACCOMPANIED BY LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS AS IT PROPAGATES SOUTHEASTWARD TOWARD THE ARKANSAS BORDER THROUGH 05-07Z...BEFORE BEGINNING TO INGEST MORE STABLE AIR AND WEAKEN. OTHERWISE...LOW-LEVEL THERMAL AND MOISTURE ADVECTION MAY CONTINUE TO SUPPORT A BAND OF CONVECTION TO THE WEST NORTHWEST. BENEATH CONTINUING STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...SIZABLE CAPE MAY SUPPORT A CONTINUING RISK FOR OCCASIONALLY SEVERE HAIL. BUT THE OVERALL SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL APPEARS LIMITED BY THE RATHER MODEST STRENGTH OF THE LOW-LEVEL JET AND DEEP LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: HEAVY RAINFALL RATES OF 1.5-2 INCH PER HOUR ARE EXPECTED TO PERSIST ACROSS THE WEST CENTRAL AND SWRN MO COUNTIES OF NERN VERNON...SRN ST CLAIR AND NRN CEDAR DURING THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. MEANWHILE...ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT IN SERN KS AND SOME SWD MOVEMENT OF THE VERNON/ST CLAIR/CEDAR COUNTIES ACTIVITY WILL RESULT IN A 30-35 MILE WIDE CORRIDOR EXTENDING FROM 35 ENE CNU TO 25 NE SGF HAVING THE LIKELIHOOD FOR TRAINING STORMS PRODUCING HEAVY RAINFALL RATES.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WIND PROFILERS AND WSR-88D VWP DATA ACROSS SRN KS...OK INTO SWRN MO INDICATED A 20-25 KT SWLY LLJ EXTENDING INTO SERN KS/SWRN MO...WITH AN INCREASE IN LOW LEVEL WAA SINCE 04-05Z. REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY DURING THE LAST SEVERAL HOURS SHOWED A BAND OF STORMS THAT INITIALLY DEVELOPED OVER FAR NRN VERNON TO NRN ST CLAIR COUNTIES BETWEEN 03-05Z HAS PRODUCED A COLD POOL WITH SLOW SWD MOVEMENT OF THIS TSTM CLUSTER. GIVEN THE INCREASE IN LOW LEVEL WAA...ADDITIONAL STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED OVER SERN KS /IN VICINITY AND N-SE OF CNU/. THIS MORE RECENT SERN KS ACTIVITY COMBINED WITH A SLOW SWD MOVEMENT OF THE WEST CENTRAL MO CLUSTER SUGGESTS A 30-35 MILE WIDE CORRIDOR FROM 35 ENE CNU TO 25 NE SGF WILL BE PRONE FOR TRAINING TSTMS AS ACTIVITY CONTINUES TO FORM ON THE WRN/SWRN FLANK OF THIS EVOLVING TSTM CLUSTER. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR IS RELATIVELY WEAK SUGGESTING A LOW THREAT FOR SEVERE WEATHER...WITH HEAVY RAINFALL RATES BEING THE PRIMARY CONCERN INTO THE EARLY MORNING...GIVEN PW VALUES EXCEEDING 1.5 INCH. THE SWLY LLJ IS EXPECTED VEER AND WEAKEN BETWEEN 12-15Z RESULTING IN DIMINISHING WAA AND STORM DEVELOPMENT AFTER 12Z. ..PETERS.. 06/17/2012
